title: Our Facility | SCENIC WORKS Advertising & Marketing Company
content:
Our Facility

A 3,000+ sqm powerhouse where cutting-edge technology meets environmental responsibility. Since 2010, Scenic Works has fused engineering precision with eco-friendly practices to deliver exhibitions, retail displays, and joinery that perform—for your brand and the planet.

Sustainable Precision at Every Stage
Eco-Conscious Materials: FSC-certified timber, recycled metals, and low-VOC finishes.
Energy-Efficient Production: Solar-powered systems and waste-reducing workflows.
Closed-Loop Practices: Scrap recycling and reusable modular designs to minimize waste.

Technology Driving Green Results
CNC routers, laser cutters, and CAD/CAM systems are optimized to reduce material waste by up to 30% versus traditional methods.

Why Clients Trust Our Facility
Zero Compromise: Sustainability without sacrificing quality or speed.
Future-Proof Compliance: Meet corporate ESG goals and green building standards.
Full Transparency: Track the eco-impact of your project from blueprint to install.

Track record
2 continents
8 countries
500+ exhibitions
100+ clients

Locations: Saudi Arabia and Dubai.
